sameNameIdsOverriddenByPrefab.note: the id already names a Texture2D, but the item prefab references a different one

itemLengthCheck.rule: computed end offset == object byte length

method: UnityPy 1.25.4: load resources.assets + globalgamemanagers.assets; resolve each MonoBehaviour m_Script PPtr to its MonoScript class in globalgamemanagers.assets; item prefabs are GameObjects carrying an 'Item' component, whose id is decoded from the Item body using the serialized layout of decompile/Item.cs (string id, float condition, bool favourited, string label, int colorSwatch, PPtr rb, PPtr affect, float wetTime, PPtr battery, float decayMultiplier, PPtr currentChunk) because this build ships no MonoBehaviour type trees - a decode is accepted only if its computed end offset equals the object's real byte length. The icon is the prefab SpriteRenderer's m_Sprite PPtr -> Sprite.m_RD.texture PPtr -> Texture2D.m_Name, taken from the prefab itself or one level of Transform children; every value is required to exist as a Texture2D name in art/out/index.json.
